selector.rationale: New left upper lobe opacification and diffuse reticulonodular interstitial prominence on chest radiograph and CT scan, consistent with Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia in an HIV-positive patient with low CD4 count

rejected.label: Toxoplasmosis
rejected.why: Already diagnosed and treated, with current symptoms more consistent with a new pulmonary infection

rejected.label: HIV-associated immune suppression
rejected.why: Not a specific diagnosis, but rather a underlying condition contributing to the patient's susceptibility to opportunistic infections

rejected.label: Cytomegalovirus infection
rejected.why: Limited evidence to support this diagnosis, with no specific findings on chest radiograph or CT scan
